E9 — 1,000-item scoped result

E9’s 1,000-item result merged in PR 26. E9-001 was registered after the result on October 17, with partial support and an explicit falsifier. It is not a completion of E2 and does not establish deployment safety.

The result discloses a verdict rule outside readable preregistration prose, selected pools, omitted calibration uncertainty and no independent replication. Its interval excludes zero but does not lie wholly beyond the 0.05 effect-size threshold.
